home.aboutDescription: Makzn 7 is a comprehensive film design services company founded in 2020. It functions as a hub for facilities such as a film design house, a prop house, a wardrobe studio, and a construction workshop. And covers all aspects of art both on and off screen; from concept, research, design, construction, and location prep.

about.aboutDescription: The process of creating art and design is built on the essence of collecting and merging the right elements to invent, create, and inaugurate. Makzn 7 collects ideas, emotions, stories, and elements to turn scripts into reality. Focusing majorly on the 7th art - Cinema, Makzn 7 is committed to provide for the industry and elevate with the highest of standards in production design and art direction.
about.servicesDescription: Makzn 7 design house offers a wide range of services, including consultation, comprehensive design solutions, and production design. The expert teams at Makzn7 comprise highly skilled local professionals who uphold exceptional international standards to deliver top-quality solutions effortlessly. With a deep understanding of cultural nuances and extensive local knowledge, Makzn7 consistently exceeds expectations in providing innovative and culturally relevant to support film, television, theater, commercials, and other creative projects. from set design, art Direction, props design, Costume Design, and graphic design.
